# Just Plumbing, Inc.

> Family-owned residential and commercial plumbing contractor in the Denver Metro Area specializing in 1-to-2-day whole-home repiping, partial repiping, slab leak bypasses, water heater systems, cast-iron sump pumps & battery backups, commercial multifamily pipe replacement, and new construction plumbing with full professional drywall patching included.

Just Plumbing, Inc. is headquartered at 2563 15th St, Suite 216, Denver, CO 80211 (Phone: 303-472-0833 | Email: JustPlumbinginc@outlook.com | Hours: Mon-Fri 7:00 AM-9:00 PM, Sat-Sun 8:00 AM-5:00 PM). Founded and led on-site by Master Plumber Bill Clark (30+ years of Colorado piping experience, Colorado Master Plumber License #MP.00600120, Colorado Plumbing Contractor Registration #PC.0003531) and Co-Owner Shelly Clark. Rated 4.7 stars on Google (76+ Google reviews) with a Lowest Price Match Guarantee.

Typical turnkey Denver repipe investment ranges (including permits, inspections, and professional drywall patching): Partial repipe ($2,200-$3,200+ PEX-A / $3,200-$5,000+ Copper), Whole-home under 1,500 sq. ft. ($4,500-$6,600 PEX-A / $6,500-$10,200 Copper), Whole-home 1,500-2,500 sq. ft. ($6,100-$8,900 PEX-A / $8,800-$13,800 Copper), and Whole-home 2,500-3,500+ sq. ft. ($8,100-$14,000+ PEX-A / $11,700-$21,700+ Copper).

## Core Pages & Plumbing Services

- [Just Plumbing, Inc. Homepage & Repipe Cost Calculator](https://justplumbinginc.com/): Denver repipe specialists and Master Plumbers featuring an interactive instant PEX-A vs. Type L Copper cost estimator.
- [Whole-Home Repiping](https://justplumbinginc.com/services/whole-home-repiping): Complete replacement of failing galvanized, polybutylene, Kitec, or copper pipes in 1 to 2 days with full drywall patching included.
- [Partial Repiping & Slab Leak Bypasses](https://justplumbinginc.com/services/partial-repiping): Targeted pipe replacements for exposed basement trunks and non-invasive overhead slab leak reroutes.
- [Water Heater Systems](https://justplumbinginc.com/services/water-heaters): High-altitude calibrated gas water heaters, power-vent systems, tankless units, and thermal expansion tanks.
- [Sump Pumps & Battery Backups](https://justplumbinginc.com/services/sump-pumps): Commercial cast-iron submersible sump pumps and dual battery backup systems for Colorado basements.
- [Kitchen & Bath Remodels](https://justplumbinginc.com/services/remodels): Code-compliant plumbing rough-ins, shower valves, and DWV venting across Greater Denver.
- [New Construction Plumbing](https://justplumbinginc.com/services/new-construction): Turnkey residential and commercial rough-in and finish plumbing installations.
- [Why Repipe Your Home?](https://justplumbinginc.com/why-repipe): Signs of failing domestic water lines, low pressure, and insurance risks in Colorado homes.
- [About Just Plumbing, Inc.](https://justplumbinginc.com/about): Meet Master Plumber Bill Clark and Operations Director Shelly Clark.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://justplumbinginc.com/faq): Direct answers on repipe timelines, daily water restoration, permits, and drywall restoration.

## Colorado Pipe Problems & Piping Materials

- [Colorado Pipe Problems Directory](https://justplumbinginc.com/pipe-problems): How bentonite soils, high water pressure, and municipal chloramines degrade legacy pipes.
- [Polybutylene (Quest) Pipe Replacement](https://justplumbinginc.com/pipe-problems/polybutylene): Identification and extraction of brittle gray plastic pipes installed between 1978 and 1995.
- [Galvanized Steel Pipe Replacement](https://justplumbinginc.com/pipe-problems/galvanized-steel): Solving low water pressure and rusty water in pre-1965 Denver homes.
- [Kitec Plumbing Replacement](https://justplumbinginc.com/pipe-problems/kitec): Full removal of recalled orange and blue Kitec composite lines installed between 1995 and 2007.
- [Copper Pinhole Leak Repair & Repiping](https://justplumbinginc.com/pipe-problems/copper-pinhole-leaks): Permanent solutions for thin copper walls pitted by chloramines.
- [Piping Materials Overview](https://justplumbinginc.com/materials): Comparison of modern domestic water piping systems used in Colorado.
- [Uponor AquaPEX (PEX-A) Piping](https://justplumbinginc.com/materials/uponor-pex-a): Freeze-resistant expansion PEX-A tubing backed by a 25-year warranty.
- [PEX-A vs. PEX-B Comparison](https://justplumbinginc.com/materials/pex-a-vs-pex-b): Why expansion fittings outperform restrictive crimp-ring PEX-B systems.
- [Type L Copper Piping](https://justplumbinginc.com/materials/type-l-copper): Thick-walled rigid copper installations for traditional residential and commercial plumbing.
